The '''Biodisposal Pit''' was the name assigned to the medical disposal center aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. All medical waste was incinerated in a [[fusion incinerator]] and then ejected into space.
